# Browser dependencies

- DOMPurify 3.4.15: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/releases/tag/3.4.15
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cure53/DOMPurify/3.4.15/dist/purify.min.js
  License: Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0 (upstream notice preserved).
- Marked 12.0.2: https://github.com/markedjs/marked/tree/v12.0.2
  Source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/marked/12.0.2/marked.min.js
  License: MIT (upstream notice preserved).

Files are vendored and pinned with SHA-384 integrity hashes in writeup.html.
When updating either file, update its filename and integrity hash together.
